svg.aria-label: How Typely works: ANY APP: You select text and press Ctrl+Shift+Space. → RUST CORE · TAURI 2: Reads the selection through UI Automation or the clipboard. → FLOATING PANEL: Opens next to the selection. Built in React. → RULES & SPELLING: Instant, typo-shaped fixes in about 30 ms. → AI · LOCAL FIRST: Ollama on your PC. Cloud providers only if you opt in. → REPLACE: Pastes into the same field and restores your clipboard.
